title: Grilled Lamb Brochette
description: A classic Irish-inspired dish featuring marinated lamb skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of crispy vegetables for a delicious meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb and brochette onto skewers.
Grill the lamb brochette for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, grill the crispy bell peppers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Serve the lamb brochette with the crispy bell peppers and enjoy!
